find: const p = 1 - shieldLeft / RESPAWN_SHIELD_TICKS; // 0 fresh -> 1 ending
replace: const p = shieldLeft / RESPAWN_SHIELD_TICKS; // 0 fresh -> 1 ending
why: Runs the invincible phase BACKWARDS: freshly shielded reads as about-to-expire and vice versa. Filed because issue #230 made the protected-opacity curve symmetric about the middle of the phase -- `p` and `1 - p` now give the same tank opacity -- so the assertion in `drives the invincibility overlay from shieldUntilTick` no longer discriminates it, and it did not need to before, when the curve was the monotone `0.45 + 0.55*p`. This entry exists to establish WHERE that case is caught instead rather than to assume it still is.
